title: RedStone Soul Lamp
description: Add a soul-version redstone lamp block, repelling piglins when turned on
body:
## Redstone Soul Lamp

This mod adds **Redstone Soul Lamp**, which is a soul-infused light source controlled by redstone power. When powered, it emits a glow infused with the essence of soul fire.

This type of light is perceived by certain creatures as an ominous or dangerous presence.  
While active, it can influence their behavior, causing them to instinctively avoid the area around the lamp.

On the mean time, the powered lamp could resonate with certain type of enchantment on boots.
